text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Iraqi official press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Saddam Hussein to deliever important speech on the 29th anniversary of July 17 revolution.
- Saddam receives congratulations on the revolution anniversary.
- Two vessels laden with food bought under the oil-for-food deal with the U.N. arrive at Umm Qasr port in southern Iraq.
- Editorials and articles on revolution anniversary.
